title: Looking for playtesters and feedback on my stealth puzzle game, Ghost Grid!
author: Crazy_Passage_8553
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I've been building **Ghost Grid**, a turn-based cyberpunk stealth puzzle game created largely through vibe coding. 

The concept is simple: navigate a grid, avoid security patrols, hack systems, and complete objectives. Every move matters, and the puzzles get progressively more complex.

The game is currently playable for free in your browser at [itch.io](http://itch.io), and I'd love some honest feedback! Gameplay, difficulty, controls, visual design, and overall fun factor, everything is open to feedback and player judgment, so let me hear it!

This is both a passion project and an experiment in seeing how far AI-assisted game development can go.

**Play Ghost Grid:** [https://hidden-current-studios.itch.io/ghost-grid-demo](https://hidden-current-studios.itch.io/ghost-grid-demo)

How AI was leveraged:  
\-Nearly all the visual design was created by myself in Figma  
\-Used Figma MCP to get the designs in-game to match my handcrafted files  
\-Google AI studio was the primary tool in the creation of everything  
\-Music was created with Suno.

Thanks to anyone willing to give it a try!
